title: Z1: Efficient Test-time Scaling with Code
authors_zh: Zhaojian Yu、Yinghao Wu、Yilun Zhao、Arman Cohan、Xiao-Ping Zhang
paper_type_zh: 代码推理轨迹发布、长短轨迹蒸馏与测试时预算研究
best_for_zh: 研究 rollout 轨迹、长短推理蒸馏、SFT 数据配方和 test-time compute 归因的读者
one_line: Z1 releases 107,173 Code Evol-Instruct-derived prompts with QwQ-32B-Preview response trajectories and pairs their SFT use with a token-capped Shifted Thinking Window for efficient inference.
Z1 发布 107,173 条 Code Evol-Instruct 派生问题与 QwQ-32B-Preview 完整响应轨迹，并用 Shifted Thinking Window 约束推理预算；但数据没有正确性 verifier、长短标签、许可证或去污染记录。
why: It makes the interaction between training-trace length and inference-time reasoning budget unusually concrete, while its absent verifier, short/long labels, generation/filtering code, license, and decontamination record define clear audit boundaries.
inclusion_reason: Z1 is a strong Track 5 anchor because it releases 107K teacher-generated code trajectories spanning short and long responses, connects training-trajectory length to test-time thinking budgets, and exposes a concrete shifted-window inference scaffold with a documented truncation failure.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Z1 addresses a coupled data-and-inference problem: long reasoning trajectories can transfer stronger problem solving through supervised fine-tuning, but indiscriminately long outputs increase test-time cost and may waste tokens on simpler prompts. The paper therefore studies whether a code-focused mixture of shorter and longer teacher responses can train a compact model whose reasoning length is subsequently controlled by an explicit inference budget.

The released object is concrete. The official Z1-Code-Reasoning-107K dataset has one train split with 107,173 rows in one Parquet shard. Each row contains id, question, response, and token_num_qwen; response is an unsegmented reasoning-and-answer target rather than separate thinking and final-answer fields. The paper associates simpler prompts with shorter trajectories and more complex prompts with longer ones, but the release contains no simple/complex or short/long label.

This belongs to Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data because trajectory length and the runtime thinking budget are the variables under study. It does not release multiple candidates, rejected generations, search trees, verifier scores, or per-row budget logs. The EMNLP 2025 Industry Track paper, appendices, ACL and arXiv records, official GitHub repository, and official Hugging Face data/model artifacts support an L4 Card; they do not establish correctness, licensing, decontamination, or full construction reproducibility.

Z1 处理一个相互耦合的数据与推理问题：长推理轨迹可以通过监督微调迁移更强的问题求解行为，但不加区分地生成长回答会增加测试时成本，也可能在简单问题上浪费 token。因此，论文考察由较短和较长 teacher 响应组成的代码数据能否训练一个较小模型，并在推理时用显式预算控制其思考长度。

公开数据对象很具体。官方 Z1-Code-Reasoning-107K 只有一个 train 切分，在一个 Parquet shard 中包含 107,173 行。每行字段为 id、question、response 和 token_num_qwen；response 是未分段的推理与答案目标，而不是相互独立的思考字段和最终答案字段。论文把简单提示与较短轨迹、复杂提示与较长轨迹联系起来，但发布中没有 simple/complex 或 short/long 标签。

它属于 Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data，因为研究变量是轨迹长度与运行时思考预算。它没有发布多候选、被拒绝生成、搜索树、verifier 分数或逐行预算日志。EMNLP 2025 Industry Track 论文及附录、ACL 与 arXiv 记录、官方 GitHub 仓库以及官方 Hugging Face 数据和模型工件支持本卡达到 L4；这些证据并不能建立正确性、许可证、去污染或完整构造可复现性。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central contribution is a two-stage length contract. During data construction, QwQ-32B-Preview writes response trajectories for Code Evol-Instruct questions, producing a training mixture that the paper characterizes as shorter reasoning for lower-complexity prompts and longer reasoning for higher-complexity prompts. During inference, Shifted Thinking Window (STW) limits the first reasoning pass and, if generation stops because of the length cap, appends “I overthought it, the final answer should be:” before continuing toward an answer.

The reusable data object is an answer-level prompt-response pair with a Qwen token count. It contains no step labels, branch structure, reward, judge verdict, execution result, correctness bit, or separate terminal answer. The construction feedback contract is therefore unknown: the documented approximately 3% removal targets repetitive reasoning, not answer correctness, and is not documented as a duplicate-prompt or semantic-deduplication check.

The closest comparison is long-versus-short trajectory selection under a fixed 74M-token training budget, together with R1-Distill-Qwen-7B as the efficiency baseline. Z1 differs by combining heterogeneous teacher-trace length with a runtime continuation scaffold. STW is a budget mechanism, not a learned verifier, and the released token count is length metadata rather than evidence that a trajectory is correct or useful.

核心贡献是一项两阶段长度契约。数据构造时，QwQ-32B-Preview 为 Code Evol-Instruct 问题生成响应轨迹，形成论文所描述的训练混合：较低复杂度提示对应较短推理，较高复杂度提示对应较长推理。推理时，Shifted Thinking Window（STW）限制第一轮思考；若生成因长度上限停止，则追加 “I overthought it, the final answer should be:” 再继续生成答案。

可复用数据对象是带 Qwen token 计数的答案级提示—响应对。它不包含步骤标签、分支结构、reward、judge 判决、执行结果、正确性位或独立终点答案。因此，其构造反馈契约为 unknown：文档所述约 3% 的移除针对重复推理，而非答案正确性，也没有被说明为提示去重或语义去重检查。

最接近的比较是在固定 74M-token 训练预算下选择长轨迹或短轨迹，并以 R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 作为效率基线。Z1 的差异在于把异质长度的 teacher trace 与运行时续写 scaffold 结合起来。STW 是预算机制而非已学习 verifier，发布的 token 计数是长度元数据，也不是轨迹正确或有用的证据。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs and generation. Problems come from Code Evol-Instruct, described as having prompts evolved in depth and breadth. QwQ-32B-Preview generates one released response trajectory per row. The exact upstream revision, per-row source identifier, prompt-complexity label, teacher decoding temperature, seed, candidate multiplicity, and raw generation log are unknown.

Length handling and filtering. Teacher trajectories are capped at 8,192 tokens. The paper reports removing approximately 3% of samples with repetitive reasoning and says fewer than 1% of retained data are truncated. It does not release the repetition detector, threshold, implementation, discarded-row manifest, or truncation flag. This operation must not be recast as correctness filtering or as a verified deduplication procedure.

Released output. The official Hugging Face revision exposes 107,173 rows in one train-only Parquet shard with id: string, question: string, response: string, and token_num_qwen: int64. There is no source, difficulty, short/long, truncation, final-answer, verifier, reward, or correctness field. The repository preprocessing uses question as the user message, masks its tokens from loss, and supervises the full response plus the end marker; the paper deliberately does not split trajectories with paired think delimiters.

SFT and runtime scaffold. Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct is fine-tuned for 2 epochs with learning rate 1e-5, 100 warmup steps, cosine decay, bfloat16, global batch 128, FSDP, 836 total steps, and 8 A100-80G GPUs. STW then caps the initial reasoning generation; natural termination proceeds normally, while length termination triggers the fixed direct-answer hint and a continuation. Main evaluations use a maximum of about 4,096 thinking tokens, although exact caps vary by experiment and observed average lengths are lower.

Reproduction boundary. Training, evaluation, STW, and length-sorted ablation-selection code are public. Reproduction still requires pinning the checked GitHub commit and dataset revision, reconstructing the absent teacher-generation and repetition-filtering stages, and supplying decontamination and rights checks. No dataset correctness terminal predicate is documented.

输入与生成。 问题来自 Code Evol-Instruct；论文称其提示通过深度和广度演化获得。QwQ-32B-Preview 为每行生成一条公开的 response 轨迹。确切上游 revision、逐行来源标识、提示复杂度标签、teacher 解码温度、随机种子、候选数量和原始生成日志均为 unknown。

长度处理与过滤。 Teacher 轨迹上限为 8,192 token。论文报告移除了约 3% 含重复推理的样本，并称保留数据中少于 1% 被截断。它没有发布重复检测器、阈值、实现、被丢弃行清单或截断标志。该操作不能被改写为正确性过滤，也不能视为经过核验的去重流程。

发布输出。 官方 Hugging Face revision 在仅含 train 的单个 Parquet shard 中公开 107,173 行，字段为 id: string、question: string、response: string 和 token_num_qwen: int64。没有 source、difficulty、short/long、truncation、final-answer、verifier、reward 或 correctness 字段。仓库预处理把 question 作为用户消息并屏蔽其 loss，用完整 response 加结束标记进行监督；论文有意不使用成对的 think 分隔符切分轨迹。

SFT 与运行时 scaffold。 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct 微调 2 个 epoch，学习率为 1e-5，warmup 100 步，采用 cosine decay、bfloat16、全局 batch 128、FSDP，共 836 步并使用 8 张 A100-80G。随后，STW 限制初始推理生成：自然结束时正常返回，因长度结束时则追加固定的直接回答提示并继续生成。主评测使用约 4,096 thinking token 的最大预算，但不同实验的精确上限有所变化，实际平均长度低于上限。

复现边界。 训练、评测、STW 和按长度排序的消融选择代码已经公开。复现仍需固定已核验的 GitHub commit 与数据 revision，重建缺失的 teacher 生成和重复过滤阶段，并补做去污染与权利检查。数据集没有披露正确性 terminal predicate。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The evidence is author-reported model and budget evidence, not a validation of released-row correctness.

  • Main evaluation. Table 1 reports Z1-7B at 76.4 on MATH500, 47.5 on GPQA Diamond, 35.3 on LiveCodeBench, and 22.3 on BigCodeBench-Hard, for a four-task average of 45.4. The authors describe performance as comparable to R1-Distill-Qwen-7B while using about 30% of its average thinking tokens. Evaluation uses one greedy sample per question at temperature 0; this does not disclose the teacher-generation temperature.
  • Budget curve. Appendix Table 8 reports GPQA 47.5 at an observed average of 2,470 thinking tokens, LiveCodeBench 35.3 at 866, and MATH500 76.4 at 1,185 under varied maximum budgets. These points support a budget-performance analysis, but do not identify which released training rows caused the behavior.
  • Trajectory-length ablation. Under a 74M-token training budget, the longest-greedy subset has 33K samples, mean trajectory length 2,216, and three-task average 50.8; the shortest-greedy subset has 90K samples, mean length 807, and average 49.1. The full 107K setting reports average 53.1 and average thinking tokens 1,507, versus 50.1/1,390 for random 64K and 48.5/1,236 for random 16K. This shows a measured length/quantity trade-off within the tested recipe, not universal superiority of long traces.
  • STW ablation and negative case. Table 3 reports with-versus-without-STW scores of 76.4/74.0 on MATH500, 47.5/25.8 on GPQA, and 35.4/34.5 on LiveCodeBench, with cut-off rates of 11.4%, 41.4%, and 4.25%. Appendix D.3 shows that a 2,048-token thinking cap can truncate reasoning and produce 11 instead of the correct 29. Table 3's 35.4 differs slightly from the 35.3 reported in Tables 1 and 8.

以下证据是作者报告的模型与预算证据，不是对发布数据行正确性的验证。

  • 主评测。 表 1 报告 Z1-7B 在 MATH500、GPQA Diamond、LiveCodeBench 和 BigCodeBench-Hard 上分别为 76.4、47.5、35.3 和 22.3，四项平均为 45.4。作者称其性能可与 R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 比较，而平均 thinking token 约为后者的 30%。评测对每个问题使用一个温度为 0 的贪婪样本；这并没有披露 teacher 生成温度。
  • 预算曲线。 附录表 8 在不同最大预算下报告：GPQA 为 47.5，实际平均 2,470 thinking token；LiveCodeBench 为 35.3，平均 866；MATH500 为 76.4，平均 1,185。这些点支持预算—性能分析，但不能识别哪些公开训练行导致了该行为。
  • 轨迹长度消融。 在 74M-token 训练预算下，longest-greedy 子集包含 33K 样本，平均轨迹长度 2,216，三任务平均 50.8；shortest-greedy 子集包含 90K 样本，平均长度 807，平均 49.1。完整 107K 设置报告平均 53.1、平均 thinking token 1,507；随机 64K 为 50.1/1,390，随机 16K 为 48.5/1,236。这显示的是该配方内经测量的长度与数量权衡，而不是长轨迹普遍更优。
  • STW 消融与负例。 表 3 报告使用和不使用 STW 时：MATH500 为 76.4/74.0，GPQA 为 47.5/25.8，LiveCodeBench 为 35.4/34.5，对应 cut-off rate 为 11.4%、41.4% 和 4.25%。附录 D.3 显示 2,048-token 思考上限会截断推理并输出 11，而正确答案为 29。表 3 的 35.4 与表 1、表 8 的 35.3 存在轻微差异。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Z1's contribution is not a new correctness signal or a conventional best-of-N selector. It treats response length as a joint construction and deployment variable: Code Evol-Instruct prompt complexity is paired with naturally shorter or longer QwQ-32B-Preview trajectories for SFT, then STW imposes a runtime thinking cap while preserving a route to a final answer after length termination.

The trajectory-length and sample-count ablations make this more specific than a generic “distill a long CoT” recipe. They compare longest-greedy, shortest-greedy, full-data, and random subsets under stated token budgets, so readers can separate some effects of response length from sample count. The public schema also exposes token_num_qwen, enabling length-stratified inspection even though it does not expose the paper's latent simple/complex grouping.

The components themselves—teacher distillation, decoder-only SFT, output truncation, and a forced-answer prompt—are established techniques. The track-level value is their explicit coupling and the documented failure when the budget is too small. Before reuse, the missing correctness gate, raw generation/filtering pipeline, rejected trajectories, and per-row construction labels must remain visible; benchmark gains do not fill those gaps.

Z1 的贡献不是新的正确性信号，也不是常规 best-of-N 选择器。它把响应长度视为一个联合的数据构造与部署变量：Code Evol-Instruct 提示的复杂度与 QwQ-32B-Preview 自然产生的较短或较长轨迹一起进入 SFT，随后 STW 在运行时施加思考上限，并在因长度终止后保留继续生成最终答案的路径。

轨迹长度与样本数量消融使其比泛化的“蒸馏长 CoT”配方更具体。实验在已说明的 token 预算下比较 longest-greedy、shortest-greedy、完整数据和随机子集，使读者能够部分区分响应长度与样本数量的作用。公开 schema 还提供 token_num_qwen，可以按长度分层检查，尽管它没有公开论文中隐含的 simple/complex 分组。

Teacher 蒸馏、decoder-only SFT、输出截断和强制回答提示本身都是已有技术。对本 track 而言，价值在于把它们显式耦合，并记录预算过小时的失败。复用前，缺失的正确性门槛、原始生成与过滤流程、被拒绝轨迹和逐行构造标签都必须保持可见；基准增益不能填补这些空白。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Unknown feedback quality. No execution checker, unit-test result, answer-equivalence rule, judge score, reward, or acceptance label is documented or released. A fluent QwQ-32B-Preview response may contain incorrect code or reasoning. Treating the approximately 3% repetition filter as a quality verifier would be a false positive in the audit; it observes repetition, not task correctness.

Incomplete construction and selection lineage. The exact Code Evol-Instruct revision, per-row source IDs, complexity labels, teacher sampling parameters, candidate multiplicity, repetition detector, and rejected generations are absent. Fewer than 1% of retained traces are reported as truncated, but rows carry no truncation flag. Curator inference: without discarded candidates and filtering code, one cannot measure false removals, residual repetition, hidden teacher traits, or selection bias.

Governance gaps. The release has only a train split. Dataset and top-level repository licenses are unknown; the ACL paper's CC BY 4.0 license does not transfer to code or data. No training-release decontamination or duplicate-prompt control is documented, and LiveCodeBench's contamination-resistant design is not a substitute for checking overlap between Code Evol-Instruct-derived training prompts and evaluation tasks.

Budget and generalization limits. STW can convert a length overrun into a direct-answer continuation, but the 2,048-token failure shows that it can remove reasoning needed for a complex item. Cut-off rates vary substantially by benchmark, so one fixed cap is not uniformly safe. The training mixture is code-related and does not cover many science and mathematics topics; cross-domain benchmark results should not be read as disclosure of a broad training-source mixture.

Reproducibility and reporting. Training, evaluation, STW, and ablation selection are public, but teacher generation and repetition filtering are not. Reported benchmark scores have not been independently reproduced in this Card, and LiveCodeBench is reported as 35.4 in Table 3 but 35.3 in Tables 1 and 8.

反馈质量未知。 论文和发布均未记录或提供执行检查器、单元测试结果、答案等价规则、judge 分数、reward 或接受标签。流畅的 QwQ-32B-Preview 响应仍可能包含错误代码或推理。在审计中把约 3% 的重复过滤当作质量 verifier 会造成误判；它观察的是重复，而不是任务正确性。

构造与选择血缘不完整。 确切的 Code Evol-Instruct revision、逐行来源 ID、复杂度标签、teacher 采样参数、候选数量、重复检测器和被拒绝生成均缺失。论文报告保留轨迹中少于 1% 被截断，但数据行没有截断标志。Curator inference：缺少被丢弃候选和过滤代码时，无法测量误删、残余重复、隐藏 teacher 特征或选择偏差。

治理空白。 发布只有 train 切分。数据集和顶层仓库许可证均为 unknown；ACL 论文的 CC BY 4.0 许可证不会自动转移到代码或数据。文档没有说明训练数据去污染或提示去重控制；LiveCodeBench 的抗污染设计也不能替代检查 Code Evol-Instruct 派生训练提示与评测任务之间的重叠。

预算与泛化限制。 STW 可以把长度超限转换为直接回答续写，但 2,048-token 失败表明它会删除复杂样本所需的推理。不同基准的 cut-off rate 差异很大，因此一个固定上限并非普遍安全。训练混合与代码相关，没有覆盖许多科学和数学主题；跨领域基准结果不能被解读为披露了广泛的训练来源混合。

复现与报告。 训练、评测、STW 和消融选择代码已经公开，但 teacher 生成与重复过滤流程没有公开。本卡没有独立复现论文分数；此外，LiveCodeBench 在表 3 中为 35.4，在表 1 和表 8 中为 35.3。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data, Z1 is useful as a controlled baseline for studying how training-trace length interacts with inference-time thinking budgets. Researchers can stratify the 107,173 released rows by token_num_qwen, reproduce longest/shortest/random subset comparisons under a fixed training-token budget, and sweep max_tokens_for_thinking while logging natural termination, STW cut-off, continuation length, final correctness, and wall-clock cost.

It is also a practical audit case for distinguishing a response corpus from a verified rollout corpus. A stronger derivative release should add upstream source IDs, complexity and short/long labels, truncation flags, generator settings, all pre-filter candidates, repetition-filter decisions, executable correctness outcomes where applicable, and exact code/data revisions. Those fields would make selector errors and length-budget attribution inspectable.

The appropriate reuse class is recipe and audit reference; direct training reuse blocked pending license, provenance, overlap, and correctness review. The available training code makes an SFT reproduction possible in principle, but downloadability and benchmark performance do not resolve rights or row quality. STW may be reused as an inference baseline with benchmark-specific budget sweeps; it should not be presented as a verifier or as a guarantee that a forced answer remains correct.

对 Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data 而言，Z1 适合作为研究训练轨迹长度如何与推理时思考预算交互的受控基线。研究者可以按 token_num_qwen 对 107,173 行发布数据分层，在固定训练 token 预算下复现 longest、shortest 和 random 子集比较，并扫描 max_tokens_for_thinking，同时记录自然结束、STW 截断、续写长度、最终正确性和墙钟成本。

它也是区分“响应语料”和“经过验证的 rollout 语料”的实用审计案例。更强的衍生发布应增加上游来源 ID、复杂度与 short/long 标签、截断标志、generator 设置、全部过滤前候选、重复过滤判决、适用时的可执行正确性结果，以及精确的代码和数据 revision。这些字段可使 selector 错误与长度预算归因被检查。

合适的复用类别是：配方和审计参考；在许可证、来源、重叠与正确性审查完成前，阻止直接训练复用。公开训练代码原则上允许复现 SFT，但可下载性和基准表现都不能解决权利或逐行质量问题。STW 可作为推理基线，在不同基准上扫描预算；它不应被描述成 verifier，也不能保证强制续写出的答案仍然正确。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Start with Paper §§2.1–2.2 and the Hugging Face schema: the released row is id/question/response/token_num_qwen, not a labeled short/long or verified program trace.
  • Read Table 2 under its 74M-token budget; longest-greedy has fewer samples than shortest-greedy, so length and count must be interpreted together.
  • Treat the approximately 3% removal as repetition filtering, not correctness verification or documented semantic deduplication; the detector and rejected rows are absent.
  • Use Table 3 and Appendix D.3 together: STW can recover answers after a cap, but a 2,048-token budget can truncate necessary reasoning and change a correct answer to a wrong one.
  • Before reuse, resolve the dataset/code license, upstream revision and per-row lineage, decontamination and prompt overlap, teacher-generation settings, truncation flags, and missing rejected-generation manifest.

• 先读论文第 2.1–2.2 节和 Hugging Face schema：公开行是 id/question/response/token_num_qwen，不是带 short/long 标签或经过验证的程序轨迹。
  • 应在 74M-token 预算下阅读表 2；longest-greedy 的样本数少于 shortest-greedy，因此轨迹长度与样本数量必须一起解释。
  • 把约 3% 的移除视为重复过滤，而不是正确性验证或已记录的语义去重；检测器和被拒绝行均未发布。
  • 将表 3 与附录 D.3 一起阅读：STW 可以在达到上限后促使模型回答，但 2,048-token 预算会截断必要推理并把正确答案变成错误答案。
  • 复用前需解决数据集和代码许可证、上游 revision 与逐行血缘、去污染与提示重叠、teacher 生成设置、截断标志和缺失的被拒绝生成清单。

title: Citation
